name: Storzen – Shop Customizer for WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Storzen is a flexible and powerful plugin that allows store owners and developers to design visually stunning WooCommerce product displays. Create custom product sections for your homepage, landing pages, or promotional campaigns — all without touching a single line of code.

Instead of the default WooCommerce layouts, you gain full control over product presentation, improving user engagement, UX, and conversions. Integrated seamlessly with Elementor, Storzen empowers anyone to design professional WooCommerce shops quickly and efficiently.

Key Features

Grid Layouts

Flexible, fully customizable product grids for any store style.

Carousel Sliders

Interactive sliders for featured or trending products.

Tabbed Products

Organize by categories, latest, best sellers, or featured items — all in one widget.

List View Layout

Present products in a detailed list format for easy comparison.

Responsive Design

Fully optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile out of the box.

Elementor Integration

Drag-and-drop widgets that appear natively in Elementor’s panel for fast, code-free page building.

Use Cases

Homepage Design

Engage visitors with attractive product sections that drive conversions.

Landing Pages

Showcase targeted products in high-converting, focused layouts.

Product Showcases

Highlight specific categories, collections, or seasonal items.

Why Choose Storzen?

  • No Coding Required — Perfect for beginners and designers alike. Fully visual setup.
  • Fully Responsive — Works beautifully on all devices without extra configuration.
  • Seamless Elementor Integration — Drag-and-drop widgets appear natively in Elementor’s panel.
  • Boost Conversions — Improved product presentation leads to higher engagement and sales.
  • Easy Product Filtering — Display products by categories, tags, featured status, best sellers, and more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce and Elementor are both installed and active.
  4. Open any page in Elementor and find Storzen widgets in the panel to start building.
sections.faq:
Does Storzen require WooCommerce to work?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and activated for Storzen to function properly.

Do I need Elementor to use Storzen?

Elementor is required to unlock all widgets and layout features, as Storzen is built to enhance the Elementor and WooCommerce experience.

Is Storzen beginner-friendly?

Yes, it is designed with a user-friendly interface suitable for users of all experience levels.

Can I create product sliders or tabbed sections?

Yes, Storzen includes product grids, carousels (sliders), tabbed sections, and list view layouts.

Is it mobile responsive?

Absolutely. All layouts created with Storzen adapt automatically to desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I display specific products or categories?

Yes. You can filter and display products by category, tag, featured status, best sellers, and more.

Does Storzen work with all WooCommerce themes?

It works seamlessly with most well-coded WordPress themes that support WooCommerce and Elementor.

Do I need coding skills?

No coding skills are required. Storzen allows you to fully customize your shop through a visual interface.

Where can I get support?

Support is available via the official WordPress.org support forum for this plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Renamed plugin to Storzen – Shop Customizer for WooCommerce.
  • Updated plugin slug to storzen.
  • Updated all internal prefixes from WCSB_ / wcommero_ to STZN_ / storzen_.
  • Updated text domain to storzen throughout all files.
  • Updated PHP namespace to DevHasib\Storzen\Elementor.
  • Updated Elementor widget category and filter hooks.

1.0.3

  • Fixed inline style output to use wp_add_inline_style().
  • Fixed Elementor widget namespaces to avoid collision with Elementor core namespace.
  • Added Requires Plugins header for WooCommerce and Elementor.
  • Documented all third-party libraries in readme.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
